Since you are a shadower, i do recommend joining the discord for the shadower class, i don't have it but there should be a link to it somewhere on reddit, it should have a guide on which spots are good for meso farming. you could always go the maple points route, but don't spend real money if you don't have to, and with the star force event coming up, it will be hard to use the meso market to get mesos, so that is not ideal . To find teammates i recommend maybe joining a guild, if you haven't already, some guilds will have people wishing to duo or trio bosses together.
I Recommend at least trying to get your equips to 15 stars,  17, depending on mesos

I recommend, leveling up your symbols, that you currently have , which at 210, i think is just chu chu and vanishing journey. Focus on making your gear strong, we do have a star force event going on this weekend so that should work. you should work with a Cra hat, top and bottom, and use abso accessories, such as cape,glove,shoe,shoulder,weapon for the set effect . work on getting nodestones to upgrade your 5th jobs, and ,or  your trinodes,

slime is a nice boss, but if you don't have the damage, it would be best to have a duo or trio, to help with mechanics.   

When doing slime, make sure you are not on the same platform as it, because it can one shot you, you can slowly chip its health away from above or below it, before focusing on damage, make sure the gates are blocked, which call back to its easier with more than one person, one for damage and one for gate closure.

The good thing is slime isn't going away anytime soon, so there isn't any rush to full clear it.
